description: Retrieve supported Census County Business Patterns (2023) or ACS five-year estimates (2023/2024) for one state or county, using explicit FIPS codes. CBP: employer establishments, employment and payroll in thousands of USD, optionally by supported industry. ACS: population, median household income and margins of error. Historical reference periods, missing/suppressed data and geography stay explicit; not current market size or a complete competitor count. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

industry.description: Optional NAICS industry; default00 all covered employer industries.

name: buscalc_census_business_data_lookup
title: Census business and community references
